endorsements.label: No Mas – How One Side-Channel Flaw Opens Atm, Pharmacies and Government Secrets Up to Attack
endorsements.description: Hacking ‘high security’ electronic locks has become a bit of a hobby, but what if you identify an unpatchable design pattern that unlocks buckets of cash and government secrets? How long do wait before telling ‘people’? let’s talk about how these locks are designed, where they fail and we can rip this band-aid off together.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 27
